text: And then a strange thing happened: the fear didn't leave the boat — it changed direction.
Mark says they feared exceedingly — more awe after the calm than in the storm — and they asked each other: what kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea do what he says?
They knew the old psalm that says it is God who stills the storm to a whisper.
And now they were staring at a man in dripping clothes who had just done it.
